integrity.proof: finite-policy likelihood-ratio ordering and simultaneous induction for sharp quadratic threshold
integrity.scientific_residual_risk: Classical Bayesian stopping literature may contain an implicitly equivalent decision region.
integrity.verification: 1181 exact finite assertions plus independent policy enumeration for k up to four

scientific_limitations: One selection and known finite horizon; conditional Bernoulli trials under a Beta posterior with arbitrary positive real shapes.
No assertion for multiple choices, pathwise monotone stopping, or non-Beta mixtures.
At low posterior-failure shape, the exact root exists but is generally implicit; an explicit formula is given for two future trials.
title: A sharp posterior-failure threshold for Bayesian last-success stopping
